posts.title: BEHIND THE NATURE COVER
posts.caption:
How rigorous reference-region math and quantitative PET analytics helped shape a landmark Nature cover story (Sevigny et al., Nature 2016; Chiao et al., J Nucl Med 2018).

During my time leading Translational & Advanced Analytics (Biomarkers) at Biogen, we demonstrated how reference/target region selection in Amyloid PET SUVR directly impacts longitudinal treatment effect detection in Alzheimer's disease clinical trials.

#Alzheimers #ClinicalTrials #AmyloidPET #Neuroimaging #Biotech #Biomarkers #NatureJournal #ANTsX

posts.title: THE ANTsX ECOSYSTEM
posts.caption:
The ANTsX Ecosystem: 18+ years of open-source medical image registration, morphometry, and deep learning (Tustison et al., Scientific Reports 2021 & 2024).

From foundational C++ diffeomorphisms (SyN) and bias correction (N4ITK) to pre-trained PyTorch/TensorFlow networks in ANTsPyNet and automated multi-modal trial QC in ANTsPyMM.

Explore the code: github.com/ANTsX

#OpenSource #ANTsX #ANTsPy #MedicalImaging #DeepLearning #Neuroscience #Python #RStats #ITK

posts.title: NSA-FLOW
posts.caption:
Introducing NSA-Flow (Non-Negative Stiefel Approximating Flow): Orthogonalish Matrix Optimization for Interpretable Embeddings (arXiv:2511.06425).

High-dimensional biomedical data (MRI, genomics, multi-omics) demands latent features that are both sparse and non-redundant. NSA-Flow operates as a smooth flow near the Stiefel manifold with proximal updates—delivering interpretable representations that generalize across cohorts.

Code: github.com/stnava/nsa_flow

#PyTorch #MachineLearning #ManifoldLearning #MatrixFactorization #InterpretableAI #Genomics #Neuroimaging

posts.title: SiMLR MULTI-VIEW AI
posts.caption:
How do you fuse structural MRI, functional connectivity, diffusion tensors, and genetics when every modality has thousands of dimensions?

Developed during my Visiting Scholar fellowship at Brown University's ICERM and published in Nature Computational Science (Avants, Tustison & Stone, 2021), SiMLR projects multi-modal biomedical data into joint, biologically interpretable low-dimensional spaces.

#NatureComputationalScience #MultiModalAI #BrainMapping #DataScience #Mathematics #ICERM #ANTsX

posts.title: MAPPING INVISIBLE WOUNDS
posts.caption:
Quantifying the neurological effects of repetitive low-level blast overpressure in career breachers and Special Operations personnel (Stone, Avants, Tustison et al., Journal of Neurotrauma 2020, 2022, 2024).

By combining multi-view machine learning (SiMLR) with TSPO PET neuroinflammation imaging and the Normative Neuroimaging Library, we can detect subtle, network-level brain changes invisible to conventional clinical reads.

#TraumaticBrainInjury #Neurotrauma #Neuroimaging #PETImaging #MilitaryHealth #Biomarkers #UVA

posts.title: 49,000+ BRAINS MAPPED
posts.caption:
Scaling precision neuroimaging from single-subject diffeomorphisms to 49,000+ individuals (Scientific Reports 2024; Nature Medicine 2024; ICLR 2023; Patterns 2023).

Standardized, reproducible Image Derived Phenotypes (IDPs) and longitudinal manifold embeddings allow us to chart brain aging trajectories and subtype Parkinson's & Alzheimer's progression years before symptom onset.

#UKBiobank #PPMI #Parkinsons #Alzheimers #PrecisionMedicine #ICLR #NatureMedicine #BigData

posts.title: SyN & N4ITK
posts.caption:
Why physical coordinate invariance and diffeomorphic symmetry still matter in the era of deep learning.

When we introduced SyN (Avants et al., Medical Image Analysis 2008) and N4ITK (Tustison, Avants et al., IEEE TMI 2010), our goal was garantizar invertible, symmetric, physically grounded mappings across anatomy. In 2026, those same principles power Deep Computational Anatomy via Latent-Aligned Multiview Normalizing Flows.

#Diffeomorphisms #ComputationalAnatomy #IEEE #MedicalImageAnalysis #ComputerVision #Math
